name: Bandit
description: A road-worn outlaw who survives by ambushing travelers and knowing when to run.

features.name: Roadside Ambush
features.description: If the bandit acts before its target during the first round of combat, it gains +2 on its first attack roll against that target.

reactions.name: Cut and Run
reactions.description: After taking damage, the bandit moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Cinder Imp
description: A spiteful little fiend that nests in cold hearths and rekindles them into dangerous blazes.

features.name: Skittering Flame
features.description: The imp transforms into a streak of sparks and teleports up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Flash of Cinders
reactions.description: When hit by a creature within 5 feet, the imp releases a burst of sparks. That creature takes -2 on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

name: Mirejaw
description: A patient marsh predator with a lantern-like tongue and jaws capable of crushing a wooden boat.

features.name: Bog Camouflage
features.description: The mirejaw gains +2 on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while it is in mud or shallow water.

features.name: Drag Under
features.description: One creature grappled by the mirejaw must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet and knocked prone.

name: Gloam Stalker
description: A lean nocturnal hunter that studies its prey's fears before striking from the darkest available cover.

features.name: Lightless Pounce
features.description: After moving at least 20 feet straight toward a creature in dim light or darkness, the stalker gains +2 on its first attack roll against that creature.

features.name: Shroud
features.description: Until the start of its next turn, attack rolls against the stalker take -2.

reactions.name: Sudden Stillness
reactions.description: When targeted by an attack, the stalker becomes motionless and gains +2 to its armor class against that attack.

name: Brass Sentinel
description: A meticulous clockwork guardian whose internal engine records every threat it has ever faced.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The sentinel makes two attacks.

features.name: Guard Protocol
features.description: While within 5 feet of an ally, the sentinel gains +2 on checks and saving throws made to resist being moved.

reactions.name: Interposing Plate
reactions.description: When an ally within 5 feet is attacked, the sentinel grants that ally +2 to armor class against the attack.

name: Rime Witch
description: A solitary winter mage who bargains in memories and preserves her favorite trophies in enchanted ice.

features.name: Frozen Veil
features.description: For 1 minute, a layer of enchanted ice grants the witch +2 to armor class. The veil ends early if she takes fire damage.

features.name: Winter's Grasp
features.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 frost damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature that fails also has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Rimeward
reactions.description: When the witch takes frost damage, she reduces that damage by 10 and gains +2 on her next spell attack roll.

name: Ossuary Moth
description: A broad-winged undead scavenger that lines its dusty body with fragments of bone from forgotten graves.

features.name: Deathly Dust
features.description: Creatures within 10 feet make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 4d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

features.name: Silent Wings
features.description: The moth gains +2 on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while flying.

reactions.name: Papery Evasion
reactions.description: When targeted by an attack, the moth twists its wings and gains +2 to armor class against that attack.

name: Dune Reaver
description: A burrowing desert horror whose armored fins cut through sand as easily as a shark's fin cuts water.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The reaver makes one Mandible Shear attack and one Tail Barb attack.

features.name: Sand Swim
features.description: The reaver can burrow through loose sand at its full speed and gains +2 on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect movement above it.

features.name: Burst From Sand
features.description: After emerging from burrowing, the reaver gains +2 on its next attack roll before the end of its turn.

reactions.name: Granular Guard
reactions.description: When hit by an attack, the reaver sheds a sheet of sand and gains +2 to armor class until the start of its next turn.

name: Storm Raptor
description: A fierce aerial elemental whose feathers carry the charge and pressure of an approaching storm.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The raptor makes two Storm Talon attacks.

features.name: Break of Sky
features.description: Each creature within 15 feet makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Ride the Bolt
reactions.description: When the raptor would take lightning damage, it instead teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Mycelial Matron
description: An ancient fungal intelligence that tends a forest of molds and speaks through the bodies rooted in its garden.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The matron makes two attacks.

features.name: Fungal Network
features.description: While touching soil, the matron gains +2 on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can sense creatures within 30 feet that are also touching the ground.

features.name: Bloom of Decay
features.description: Creatures within 20 feet make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Spore Burst
reactions.description: After taking damage from a creature within 10 feet, the matron releases spores. That creature takes 2d6 poison damage and takes -2 on its next saving throw.

name: Rift Hound
description: A many-eyed fiend that pursues its quarry through folded space and always arrives a heartbeat too soon.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The hound makes two Phase Fangs attacks.

features.name: Rift Sense
features.description: The hound gains +2 on initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect invisible creatures.

features.name: Fold Space
features.description: The hound teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Sidestep
reactions.description: When targeted by an attack, the hound shifts partway into a rift, imposing -2 on the attack roll.

name: Forge Tyrant
description: A giant war-smith who treats conquered fortresses as raw material and prisoners as apprentices.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The tyrant makes two attacks.

features.name: Furnace Aura
features.description: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the tyrant takes 2d6 fire damage.

features.name: Hammerfall
features.description: Creatures within 15 feet make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail are also knocked prone.

reactions.name: Tempered Rebuke
reactions.description: After taking damage from a melee attack, the tyrant deals 3d8 fire damage to the attacker.

name: Pale Mirror
description: An aberrant reflection that escaped its silvered prison and now collects the faces and memories of living creatures.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The mirror makes two attacks.

features.name: Borrowed Face
features.description: The mirror gains +2 on Charisma (Deception) checks and can mimic the voice of any creature whose reflection it has seen.

features.name: Duplicate
features.description: The mirror creates an illusory double for 1 minute. While the double is within 30 feet, attack rolls against the mirror take -2.

reactions.name: Return to Sender
reactions.description: When hit by a spell attack, the mirror reduces the damage by 10 and deals 3d8 psychic damage to the attacker.

name: Starved Cathedral
description: A mobile shrine animated by centuries of unanswered prayers, still seeking worshippers to fill its hollow nave.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The cathedral makes two attacks.

features.name: Hollow Nave
features.description: The cathedral gains +2 on saving throws against effects that would move it or knock it prone.

features.name: Processional
features.description: The cathedral moves up to its speed. Creatures in its path make a DC 19 Strength saving throw, taking 5d10 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure.

reactions.name: Toll for the Living
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell, the cathedral rings its great bell. The caster takes 4d8 force damage and takes -2 on the next roll made as part of that spell.

name: Ash Wyrm
description: A furnace-hearted dragon that sleeps beneath burned cities and dreams of the next great fire.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The wyrm makes one Furnace Bite attack and two Wyrm Claw attacks.

features.name: Ash Cloud
features.description: The wyrm exhales a 30-foot cone of burning ash. Creatures in the area make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.description: If the wyrm fails a saving throw, it can expend one use to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Backdraft
reactions.description: After taking damage from a creature within 15 feet, the wyrm exhales a sudden flare. That creature takes 4d8 fire damage.

legendary_actions.name: Smolder
legendary_actions.description: The wyrm makes one Cinder Ray attack.

legendary_actions.name: Coiling Advance
legendary_actions.description: The wyrm moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Buffet
legendary_actions.description: Creatures within 10 feet make a DC 20 Strength saving throw, taking 3d8 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure.

name: Tidebound Leviathan
description: A colossal elemental that carries an entire ecosystem within the currents spiraling around its body.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The leviathan makes one Undertow Maw attack and one Crest Slam attack.

features.name: Maelstrom
features.description: Creatures within 30 feet make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 7d8 bludgeoning damage and is pulled 20 feet toward the leviathan. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not moved.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.description: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can expend one use to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Crushing Undertow
reactions.description: When a creature within 20 feet moves away, the leviathan pulls it 10 feet closer and deals 4d8 bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Current Lash
legendary_actions.description: The leviathan makes one Waterspout attack.

legendary_actions.name: Rime Surge
legendary_actions.description: One creature within 20 feet takes 3d8 frost damage and has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Depth Charge
legendary_actions.description: Creatures within 20 feet make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Vesper Seraph
description: A winged arbiter of dusk sent to settle conflicts that have lasted beyond their appointed ending.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The seraph makes two attacks.

features.name: Twilight Aura
features.description: Allies within 15 feet gain +2 on saving throws against being frightened, while hostile creatures in the area take -2 on checks to hide.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.description: If the seraph fails a saving throw, it can expend one use to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Measured Judgment
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, the seraph imposes -2 on that roll. If the attack misses, the attacker takes 3d8 radiant damage.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Step
legendary_actions.description: The seraph moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Gloaming
legendary_actions.description: One creature within 30 feet takes 4d8 necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Edict
legendary_actions.description: Each hostile creature within 20 feet makes a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5d8 radiant damage and takes -2 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

name: Null Behemoth
description: A mountain-sized absence given appetite, leaving smooth and empty spaces wherever its passage erases the world.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The behemoth makes one Unmaking Bite attack and one Gravity Horn attack.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.description: Creatures within 40 feet make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 8d8 force damage and is pulled 20 feet toward the behemoth. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not moved.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.description: If the behemoth fails a saving throw, it can expend one use to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Unmake Effect
reactions.description: When targeted by a spell, the behemoth gains +2 to its armor class and saving throws against that spell. If the spell deals damage, the behemoth reduces that damage by 20.

legendary_actions.name: Gravity Step
legendary_actions.description: The behemoth teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Rend Space
legendary_actions.description: The behemoth makes one Null Ray attack.

legendary_actions.name: Devour Light
legendary_actions.description: Light within 40 feet dims until the end of the behemoth's next turn. Hostile creatures in the area take 5d8 force damage and take -2 on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

name: Sepulcher Sovereign
description: An undead monarch whose decree binds every soul buried within the borders of its former kingdom.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The sovereign makes two attacks.

features.name: Court of the Dead
features.description: Spectral courtiers fill a 20-foot radius around the sovereign until the end of its next turn. Hostile creatures that enter the area for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 5d8 necrotic damage.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.description: If the sovereign fails a saving throw, it can expend one use to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Royal Decree
reactions.description: When targeted by an attack or spell, the sovereign imposes -2 on the attack roll or grants itself +2 on the saving throw. The source then takes 3d8 psychic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Grave Step
legendary_actions.description: The sovereign teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Command the Dead
legendary_actions.description: One allied undead within 30 feet moves up to half its speed and gains +2 on its next attack roll.

legendary_actions.name: Soul Tithe
legendary_actions.description: Each hostile creature within 20 feet makes a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 6d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The sovereign regains hit points equal to half the total damage dealt.

name: Worldroot Ancient
description: A primordial tree-being whose roots remember the shaping of continents and whose branches shelter entire nations.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The ancient makes two Epoch Limb attacks or two Verdant Lance attacks.

features.name: Rooted in Ages
features.description: While touching natural ground, the ancient gains +2 on saving throws and cannot be moved against its will.

features.name: Worldbloom
features.description: A 40-foot radius around the ancient fills with supernatural growth for 1 minute. Hostile creatures treat the area as difficult terrain, and the ancient and its allies regain 20 hit points at the start of their turns while inside it.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.description: If the ancient fails a saving throw, it can expend one use to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Bark of Ages
reactions.description: When the ancient takes damage, it reduces that damage by 20. If the damage came from a creature within 20 feet, that creature takes 4d8 piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Rootquake
legendary_actions.description: One creature within 30 feet makes a DC 23 Strength saving throw, taking 5d10 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure.

legendary_actions.name: Regrowth
legendary_actions.description: The ancient regains 20 hit points, then makes one Verdant Lance attack.

legendary_actions.name: Canopy of Night
legendary_actions.description: A vast canopy darkens the area within 40 feet until the end of the ancient's next turn. Hostile creatures in the area take -2 on attack rolls and 5d8 necrotic damage.
